findings.title: Preserve range-variable detection before interpolation
findings.body: `querySupportsSplitting` runs after this interpolation and relies on `isQueryWithRangeVariable` to keep `$__range` queries unsplit. If `applyTemplateVariables` expands `$__range` using the original request range, that check no longer sees the token and the query is split; each subrequest then uses a fixed full-range duration instead of the range for that subrequest. This produces incorrect results. Preserve the original expression for the splitting check, or otherwise keep range-variable queries unsplit.

findings.title: Shard queries are interpolated twice
findings.body: Shard splitting interpolates each target here, then passes it to `runSplitQuery`, which now calls `applyTemplateVariables` again before execution. The second pass can expand variable-like text introduced by the first interpolation—for example, a variable value containing `$name` or a Grafana macro—changing the query unexpectedly. Avoid re-interpolating already-prepared shard targets, or ensure interpolation happens only once.
